issues.on_page: Schedule B operating account: total receipts 4,173,535.03 (1510 59,491.73; 1990 6,282.84). issues.issue: Leaving out B, C and D to avoid double counting is defensible, because Schedule A ties to the statements. But Schedule A interest 59,609.21 = B 59,491.73 + C 35.37 + D 82.11, so C and D interest is inside the General Fund while their other receipts and disbursements are not. Also, the notes have the sign of the B-vs-A interest difference wrong: B is 117.48 lower, not higher. And the 1990 difference (B 2,185.20 higher) is unexplained. A person should confirm that leaving out C and D is right.
